measurementNotes: Actual production codec bytes, excluding Forge/TCP framing. In-process replicas and deterministic engine ticks, not real multiplayer latency. No FPS claim.

manualClientAcceptance.source: User reports all seven requested checks passed exactly as expected
checks: normal highlight colors and damage priority
same-coordinate cross-dimension selection and skipped counts
large selection and subsequent smaller selection
dedicated server: independent selections and reconnect
manualClientAcceptance.limitations: Exact packet reordering and capacity boundaries are automated evidence; manual report does not establish a 50000-position in-game heap profile.
